title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil


SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .


Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.


Visit our website: siila.Com.Br


About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Solution Architect


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Participate in process and business requirements sessions and document to-be business processes leveraging industry best practices.
  • Identify and collect data, such as historical sales, shipment, inventory, logistics, and other operations / supply chain data from sources like databases, excel sheets, emails and others.
  • Ability to convert business logic to technical platform design, including knowledge of platform infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Architects and Directors to develop clear functional and technical design and document data requirements and build complex datasets.
  • Configure a technical specification document and tool configuration in the o9 platform as per the design to solve deep operations / supply chain problems and institute rigorous performance monitoring systems.
  • Use mathematical models, predictive methods, statistical techniques, optimization algorithms and simulations to analyze, manipulate and interpret large enterprise data and provide business insights and data visualization to the client management.
  • Be proficient in statistical and optimization tools and programming languages to conduct data integration through extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) and create models to generate time series forecasts and operational plans
  • Work with Internal Research and Development Teams to resolve solution gaps and deploy fixes in the customer environment
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test-cases and document issues and track progress at resolving issues.
  • Ability to design a testing protocol and implement with support from Junior Analysts, with the end goal of automating testing.
  • Work with Cross-Functional Teams, and IT and business stakeholders, to ensure successful planning and execution of projects.
  • Plan, develop and deliver Super User and End User training, for a global user base.
  • Mentor Junior Analysts to familiarize them with technical and business aspects of a project.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: Implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics organization.
  • Experience presenting on complex topics in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner
  • Prior experience in planning systems, and exposure to ERP tools
  • Firsthand experience leading a team through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, go-live/cutover, and value realization
  • Experience using agile methodology to deliver large scale enterprise implementations
  • Education: Master’s Degree +4 or Bachelor Degree with 6 year experience required. Degrees in the following fields: in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields (including Supply Chain Engineering) with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Skills:

  • Supply planning experience and have worked or implemented one or multiple supply planning products is required
  • Knowledge of spreadsheets and software (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets), document processing (Microsoft Word, Google Docs), presentation (Microsoft PowerPoint) is required
  • Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is required
  • Strong analytical techniques, data mining knowledge and proficiency in handling and processing large amounts of data is preferred
  • Ability to identify key insights and critical thinking to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is preferred Coursework and strong background in mathematics and statistics is required
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration / training skills are required
  • Ability to communicate mathematical, technical or software usage concepts to audiences with limited prior mathematics, technical or software background is preferred
  • Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones and at executive and junior levels in a corporate hierarchy is required


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works

  1. Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  2. Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  3. Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  4. Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  5. Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  6. Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  7. HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More About Us


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Regional Sales Manager (RSM)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Company: Hanwha Vision

Department: Sales

Work Model: Field-based / On-site with travel


About Hanwha Vision


Hanwha Vision is a global leader in video surveillance and security solutions, part of the Hanwha Group. We develop advanced technologies that help create safer, smarter environments across industries such as retail, transportation, critical infrastructure, and smart cities.


As part of our continued growth in Latin America, we are seeking a Regional Sales Manager (RSM) based in São Paulo, Brazil , to drive revenue growth and market expansion for our video surveillance and security solutions across the assigned territory.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales plan for the assigned region.
  • Identify and develop strategic system integrators with tailored growth plans.
  • Execute regional action plans aligned with the company’s overall sales strategy.


Relationship Management

  • Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with system integrators, distributors, and key end customers.
  • Conduct regular meetings with strategic accounts to understand needs and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Generate demand through large end users in collaboration with consultants, engineers, architects, and technology partners.


Sales Support and Execution

  • Provide expert guidance on Hanwha Vision products and solutions.
  • Deliver sales presentations, both in-person and virtually, to promote the product portfolio.
  • Support integrators in solution design, proposal development, deal closure, and project execution.
  • Prepare and manage quotations, ensuring timely and accurate product delivery.


Order Coordination and Logistics

  • Coordinate with internal teams and distributors to ensure accurate and timely order processing.
  • Monitor order status and proactively resolve any issues.


Market Analysis and Strategic Development

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of customers, opportunities, market trends, and competitors.
  • Conduct market research to identify growth opportunities and risks.
  • Develop strategies to increase market share and achieve regional sales targets.


Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Analyze sales performance metrics and forecast regional revenue.
  • Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, and results.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM system.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Technical Support teams to align initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the STEP program to ensure system integrators maintain certifications and receive appropriate training.
  • Provide strategic market feedback to senior management to support product and marketing development.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar sales role within the technology, electronic security, or video surveillance industry.
  • Proven experience working with system integrators and distributors .
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (mandatory).
  • Strong negotiation skills, strategic thinking, results-driven mindset, and customer orientation.
  • Availability to travel within Brazil and the region as required.


What We Offer

  • The opportunity to join a global leader in video surveillance technology.
  • High-impact regional role with strategic autonomy.
  • Professional growth within an international organization.

title: Legal Specialist
description:

About the Role

The job will be mainly responsible for providing legal consultation in areas such as commercial law, sales and purchase transactions, procurement contracts, and various other legal issues under Brazilian law, particularly tax compliance, labor compliance, leasing, advertising compliance, and marketing regulations.

Reporting to the General Manager of South America and at the same time being under the administrative management of the Legal Department of the Chinese headquarters.

  1. Draft and review various commercial agreements, including sales/customer agreements, distribution and sales representative agreements, procurement agreements, licensing and development agreements, advertising endorsement agreements, etc.
  2. Handle various matters related to Brazil, including tax compliance, labor law compliance, corporate and lease contracts, dispute resolution, and other legal issues.

  4. Coordinate with cross-functional teams, offer legal options/analyze potential legal solutions, and liaise with external legal counsel.

Qualifications：

  1. Law Degree and certification to practice law in Brazil
  2. Training and certification to practice law in other countries is not required but would be a big plus.
  3. 3-5 years' experience in legal practice (either in a large, international law firm or a combination of a large law firm and in-house experience)
  4. Fluency in Portuguese and English/Mandarin.
  5. Significant experience working as a commercial attorney and providing legal advice for multinational manufacturing company.
  6. Excellent organizational and planning skills and the ability to simultaneously handle a variety of complex matters under deadline.
  7. Strong demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating contracts.
  8. Excellent written, verbal and analytical skills and an ability to communicate complex issues in a simple way and to orchestrate plans to resolve issues and mitigate risks.
  9. Ability to form strong working relationships with other employees and business partners while maintaining firm adherence to proper legal standards.
  10. Sound business judgment and strategic thinking. A flexible and proactive mindset with genuine interest in understanding the legal implications of business strategy and providing actionable recommendations.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Devops Engineer - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company


Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.


Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.


Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.


About the Role


Cloud Infrastructure & Orchestration

  • Architect and manage container platforms (AWS ECS or EKS) ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance critical for financial transactions.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation to standardize environments and ensure reproducibility across development, staging, and production.
  • Manage AWS Networking components (VPCs, Subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53, Load Balancers) with a focus on network segregation and security best practices.


CI/CD & Automation

  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to support agile software delivery while enforcing strict quality gates and security checks.
  • Automate operational tasks using Python or Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Drive the "Shift-Left" approach, integrating testing and security scanning early in the development lifecycle.


Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Configure and maintain comprehensive observability solutions (APM, dashboards, distributed tracing, and centralized logging) to ensure real-time visibility into system health.
  • Proactively monitor application performance and infrastructure metrics to prevent incidents and optimize resource utilization.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets to maintain the reliability required for a 24/7 financial operation.


Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure secure container lifecycles, managing ECR (Image Registry) with strict vulnerability scanning and patching routines for third-party and internal images.
  • Implement security controls and access management (IAM) aligned with financial regulatory standards (e.G., BACEN, LGPD) and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Security team to implement immutable infrastructure and ensure audit trails for all infrastructure changes.


Requirements

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English (technical reading and writing are essential).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Solid knowledge of Python and proficiency in Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Deep proficiency in Docker, container orchestration (ECS or EKS), and Helm.
  • Experience with AWS networking architecture and security groups.
  • Practical experience with APM tools (e.G., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) and logging stacks (ELK, Splunk, CloudWatch).


Differentiators (Nice to have)

  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect Professional.
  • CKA/CKAD (Kubernetes) Certification.
  • Prior experience in the Financial Sector (FinTechs, Banks, Payments), specifically dealing with regulatory requirements and critical mission environments.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows (e.G., ArgoCD).

title: It Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role;
experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.G., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.G., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)


Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.


Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.E. audit confirmations and PBC list)


Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.


Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.


Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.G., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience;
    experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

  • Executar projetos de regularização e reforma de equipamentos, tanto nas dependências da SIG quanto nas instalações dos clientes, realizando ajustes técnicos e reparos necessários para garantir a conformidade normativa e o pleno funcionamento dos sistemas.
  • Apoiar o departamento de qualidade na análise de RNCs (Relatórios de Não Conformidade), fornecendo insights técnicos para identificar causas raiz e colaborando no desenvolvimento de planos de ação corretiva para prevenir recorrências.
  • Oferecer consultoria técnica ao departamento comercial, analisando viabilidade técnica de novos projetos e contribuindo com informações detalhadas para a elaboração de propostas comerciais e a implementação de soluções inovadoras.

  • Conhecimento emprogramação de PLC e IHM.

  • Inglês intermediário;

O que nós oferecemos


  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale alimentação

  • Previdência Privada
  • Wellhub
  • Subsídio a estudos (conforme política)
  • Licença paternidade e maternidade estendida
  • Salário compatível com mercado.


Competências da SIG

Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.


Nosso Compromisso

A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira;
um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.


Sobre a SIG

A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad de São Paulo, Universidade Estadual Paulista, Fundação Oswaldo Fiocruz and more. We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.

  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

Bachelor's Degree

A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.


Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos para liderar e estruturar a governança financeira, operacional e processual dos projetos, garantindo rentabilidade, conformidade e melhoria contínua . Essa posição tem papel estratégico na padronização da gestão de projetos, no controle financeiro e na integração entre áreas como Comercial, Financeiro, Supply Chain, Implantação e Operações.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Analisar e aprovar abertura e encerramento de projetos, garantindo critérios, governança e registros corretos
  • Controlar faturamentos, reajustes, adiantamentos e aspectos contratuais dos projetos
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o POC (Percentual de Conclusão) sob a visão contábil e gerencial
  • Conduzir reuniões estratégicas do tipo War Room com times comerciais e técnicos
  • Padronizar e otimizar processos de gestão de projetos, metodologias e fluxos
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos em gestão de projetos para equipes técnicas
  • Realizar auditorias de processos e gestão, garantindo conformidade e melhoria contínua
  • Gerenciar a equipe de Mobilização de Portais de Clientes , assegurando eficiência operacional
  • Executar análises financeiras aprofundadas, identificando riscos e oportunidades
  • Atuar como interface estratégica com Financeiro, Supply, Implantação, Engenharia e demais áreas


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Financeira ou Controladoria
  • Sólida vivência em controladoria e finanças de projetos
  • Vivência em ambientes de projetos complexos e multidisciplinares
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Jira, Primavera P6)
  • Vivência em controladoria e finanças de projetos (orçamento, fluxo de caixa, rentabilidade, POC)
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau)
  • Vivência na elaboração de processos (BPMN) e auditorias internas
  • Vivência com ERPs e sistemas de gestão financeira
  • Inglês e Espanhol a partir do nível intermediário

title: Consultor Sap Resseguro (Fs-Ri)
description:
O que fazemos


A Unidade de Negócios de Resseguro oferece serviços de implementação baseados em estruturas comprovadas, metodologias consolidadas e melhores práticas desenvolvidas a partir da experiência global em apoiar organizações a enfrentarem desafios relacionados ao resseguro cedido e aceito utilizando o SAP S/4HANA Insurance for Reinsurance Management (FS-RI). Como parceiro de desenvolvimento da solução, somos altamente qualificados para orientar empresas em todo o processo de implementação e ajudá-las a alcançar alto grau de automação em prêmios, provisões, cálculo de comissões, processamento de sinistros e relatórios.

Nossos consultores atuam em situações de negócio complexas e internacionais, influenciam decisões estratégicas e interagem diretamente com os clientes para compreender seus processos operacionais e requisitos funcionais. Oferecemos a profissionais ambiciosos um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador, com trilhas de carreira claras e amplas oportunidades de crescimento.


O que você fará


- Analisar, mapear e melhorar processos de resseguro cedido e aceito, incluindo contratos proporcionais e não proporcionais, contabilização, movimentações de sinistros e fechamentos.

- Atuar em projetos internacionais, conduzindo discussões com times de negócio para levantar requisitos, entender operações e apoiar decisões estratégicas.

- Traduzir processos operacionais em regras e parametrizações dentro do sistema (com capacitação em SAP FS-RI e ferramentas relacionadas).

- Participar de workshops, definição de escopo, análises de gap e desenho de soluções de negócio.

- Apoiar migração de contratos, saldos, provisões técnicas e dados históricos.

- Validar cálculos de prêmios cedidos, comissões, recuperações, reservas e movimentações financeiras junto aos times de Contabilidade, Finanças e Atuarial.

- Acompanhar testes, go-live e estabilização dos processos durante o hypercare.

- Atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio, TI e parceiros de implementação.


O que buscamos


Requisitos


- Experiência sólida em processos de resseguro — contratos proporcionais e não proporcionais, contabilização, movimentações de sinistros, provisões técnicas e reporting regulatório.

- Vivência em seguradoras, resseguradoras ou consultorias atuando diretamente com operações de resseguro.

- Capacidade de analisar processos complexos, propor soluções e dialogar com diferentes áreas (Negócios, Contabilidade, Atuarial, TI).

- Graduação em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia, Atuária, Relações Internacionais, TI ou áreas correlatas.

- Inglês avançado.

- Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente em ambientes dinâmicos.


Diferenciais


- Experiência em ciclos completos de implementação de sistemas (SAP ou similares).

- Conhecimento em SAP FS-RI, FPSL, PaPM ou S/4HANA Finance.

- Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e processos de migração.

- Vivência em projetos internacionais de transformação ou modernização de processos.


O que oferecemos


- Um lugar onde os indivíduos são igualmente valorizados e onde a diversidade e as diferenças culturais são valorizadas.

- Uma equipe global de especialistas altamente respeitados da SAP e do setor, onde você pode fazer a diferença.

- Impulsione o desenvolvimento de sua carreira em direções funcionais e técnicas por meio de educação avançada abrangente e profundo conhecimento do produto.

- Receba um pacote salarial atrativo e competitivo, incluindo pagamento de incentivos e outros benefícios aos funcionários (Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação, Previdência Privada, Wellhub, Auxílio Home Office, Acesso ao SESC, Udemy Business).

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56742


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

title: Sap Sd/Mm Supervisor
description:
Main Responsabilities

We are looking for an experienced SAP SD/MM Supervisor to join our team in Brazil and play a critical role in supporting the business during the ongoing tax reform initiatives in the country, one of the most complex and transformative regulatory changes in the region.

This role was created to bring deep SAP SD/MM expertise in the Brazilian market, ensuring compliance, business continuity, and system evolution over the coming years, while also supporting LATAM/Mercosur operations and acting as a strong local IT presence, and will be responsible for:

  • Experience in SAP BASIS activities, including system upgrade and SAP OSS Notes applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP Notes discovery and implementation support
  • Deep Understanding of Brazil Tax Environment, particularly indirect taxation. Recent tax reform aims to simplify and modernize the tax system by replacing multiple existing taxes (IPI, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ST and FCP) with two new taxes: CBS (Contribution on Goods and Services) and IBS (Tax on Goods and Services).
  • Working Expertise of Inbound and Outbound Brazil Nota Fiscal (SAP Electronic Invoicing) Processes and Requirements
  • Assess as-is processes and map them into new processes and/or business flows, leveraging SAP best practices.
  • Work closely with business teams, system integrators, and stakeholders to understand needs, identify options for, and recommend optimal solutions to optimize business processes.
  • Develop expertise and serve as an SME for process and data discussions, workshops, and analysis related to Sales and Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM) processes.
  • Produce high-quality documentation, including but not limited to current-state analysis, future-state processes, workflows, data mapping, decision matrices, use cases, testing scenarios, and full business requirements.
  • Collaborate with project teams and business partners during project planning, software delivery reviews, and testing to ensure the software has been implemented according to specifications.
  • Document “business problem” to be solved and complete current state analysis and lead requirements gathering exercises through discovery sessions.
  • Provide advice, troubleshooting, and guidance for end-user support;
    identify areas for automation of manual processes and data analytics reporting.
  • Conduct meetings and deliver presentations;
    gather critical information to produce useful reports.
  • Monitor deliverables and support the timely completion of projects.


Mandatory Requirements

  • SAP experience with a strong focus on SD and MM modules in Brazil.
  • Proven experience with Brazilian indirect taxes and electronic invoicing (NF-e).
  • Experience with Mastersaf E-Invoicing.
  • Solid understanding of SAP SD/MM integration with other modules.
  • Previous experience leading or supervising SAP functional resources (internal or external).
  • Strong communication skills, able to interact with business, regional, and global stakeholders.
  • Advanced English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS, Engineering, Business, or another related field.


Desired Qualities

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and engage effectively with different audiences.
  • Sense of ownership with a positive, can-do attitude.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Innovative problem-solving skills to streamline and automate business processes.


Job Location

Vila Mariana (São Paulo)

Work modality: Hybrid

Schedule: 08:00 a.M. to 05:00 p.M.


About Stepan

Founded in 1932, Stepan Company is a leading manufacturer of basic and intermediate chemicals, including surfactants, polymers, as well as specialty ingredients used in consumer, household, and institutional products such as laundry detergents, shampoos, and surface cleaners.

Stepan Company currently operates 20 global plants and employs more than 2,000 people. We have a strong track record of growth. Our growth allows us to offer significant career opportunities and stability to our team members. We have ambitious goals at Stepan and know that every team member will be crucial in achieving them. Regardless of the role, we look for team members who bring a growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and the ability to thrive in an evolving environment.

We celebrate diversity at Stepan and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, genetic information, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

description:

title: It Data Engineer Sênior

Habilidades e competências:

title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
As the Senior Finance Manager for LATAM , you will be the cornerstone of our financial operations in the region. You will oversee all financial reporting, tax compliance, and treasury functions for our entities in Mexico and Brazil. You will act as a strategic partner to the global finance team, ensuring that our expansion is commercially viable, compliant with local laws, and operationally efficient.


Key Responsibilities


Regional Controllership & Financial Reporting

  • Monthly Financial Oversight: Lead and review the month-end closing process for LATAM entities (Brazil/Mexico), ensuring accurate reporting under Local GAAP and IFRS .
  • Financial Integrity: Implement and maintain robust internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure compliance with global corporate policies.
  • Consolidation: Standardize financial workflows and reporting templates across different LATAM jurisdictions to ensure data consistency.

Tax & Statutory Compliance

  • Local Tax Management: Supervise complex tax compliance in Brazil (Direct/Indirect taxes) and Mexico (VAT/ISR/Electronic Accounting).
  • Audit Management: Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and statutory bodies, ensuring timely and "clean" audit completions.
  • Agent Governance: Manage and hold accountable third-party corporate secretarial, tax, and legal agents across the region.

Strategic Business Expansion

  • Entity Setup: Project manage the financial and administrative aspects of new company incorporations in the region (including banking setup and tax registrations).
  • Treasury & FX: Manage regional cash flow, local liquidity, and mitigate foreign exchange risks within the LATAM portfolio.


Requirements


  • 10+ years in finance/accounting, with at least 3 years in a regional leadership role within a multinational company.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics. An MBA or professional certification (CPA, CA, or local equivalent like CRC in Brazil) is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory. Proficiency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a massive advantage given the cross-border nature of the role.
  • Deep knowledge of Latin American tax systems and experience with global ERPs (e.G., NetSuite, or Xero).
  • Strong cross-cultural communication, ability to work across time zones, and a "startup" mindset for building processes from scratch.
